# Wall-time budgets in seconds, one row per labeled verification stage.
# Linux columns name CPU classes mapped below to exact /proc/cpuinfo model
# names. Each stage/class budget is the maximum of at least its 20 most recent
# recorded runs plus 10%, rounded up to 5 s. The prior 10 s floor remains,
# rather than coming from the 2026-10-13 ruling; it can affect only stages
# whose measured maximum is below about 9 s.
# A model with fewer than 20 runs has no column. An unmapped model uses the
# stage's largest Linux class budget and is reported by name. Unsampled rows
# retain the former Linux values until per-CPU runs are recorded in
# research/investigations/test-economy/time-budgets.md.
#
# macos values remain reported references: overruns are report-only. Linux and
# Windows overruns fail the final CI verdict; a missing row for the host fails
# on every host. run-check.pl preserves the command's status and records these
# results when WHITEFOOT_TIME_BUDGET_RECORD is set. Without a record it prints
# the comparison only. "-" marks a stage that does not run on that host.
# Windows values retain their existing rule: 1.25 times the recorded maximum,
# rounded up to 5 s, with a 10 s floor, or an owner-set value. AGENTS.md "Checks"
# states how to judge an overrun; budget raises need the owner's decision.
# Windows raises keep the 10 s increment for the stage and its group, if any.

cpu epyc-7763  AMD EPYC 7763 64-Core Processor
cpu epyc-9v74  AMD EPYC 9V74 80-Core Processor
cpu epyc-9v45  AMD EPYC 9V45 96-Core Processor
# xeon-8573c is owner-directed (2026-10-13) although it has fewer than the 20
# runs a class normally needs. Each value is the larger of the row's largest
# earlier Linux class value and, where one run on this CPU was found, that
# run's time by the rule above (one gate run for the unit and runtime rows, one
# compute-regression run for the compute rows; no run for the others). Only
# compiler/test-build-unit and performance-baseline-compiler rise above the
# largest class. Evidence: research/investigations/test-economy/time-budgets.md.
# performance-candidate-compiler is 145 s for every Linux class, set by the
# owner on 2026-10-13 (it was 130 s).
cpu xeon-8573c INTEL(R) XEON(R) PLATINUM 8573C

label                           epyc-7763  epyc-9v74  epyc-9v45  xeon-8573c  macos  windows
